Removed all items. The paper uses LLMs to generate unit tests, but these are automated test cases, not LLMs judging the NLG outputs. The majority voting is based on test execution results, not LLM evaluation of code quality.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automated using test execution.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on code generation evaluation using automated unit tests. The main NLG evaluation metric is Pass@1 based on test execution. The paper's contribution is in scaling and improving unit test generation for better code solution selection, rather than traditional NLG evaluation methods.
